title: Undertrial, simple hurt case
story: Practice case (fictional). Speaker: the wife of an undertrial prisoner. Her husband was arrested on 10 January 2026. The fight happened on 5 January 2026. He is charged under BNS 115(2) (voluntarily causing hurt). He has never been convicted before and there are no other cases against him. He does not have a lawyer. He has not caused any delay. They live in Patna, Bihar. Today's date: 4 November 2026.

required.Lawyer: none (so a DLSA application is needed)

must_not: predict whether the court will grant release
